supportPolicy: Stable entries are covered by release documentation and compatibility expectations for the local stdio host. Experimental entries may evolve faster and can change with less notice before a remote host exists.
productBoundaries: The production target is the local stdio server running on a developer workstation.
Workspace state comes from MSBuildWorkspace and on-disk files, not unsaved editor buffers.
Future HTTP/SSE hosting is intentionally a separate operational tier and not part of the current stable contract.
Write-capable tools require an already loaded workspace and are intentionally bounded by preview/apply or explicit edit requests.

workflowHints.name: Preview/Apply
workflowHints.description: Most write operations use a two-step pattern: call *_preview to inspect the diff, then *_apply with the preview token.

workflowHints.name: Diagnostic Fix
workflowHints.description: Start with fast compile_check, inspect diagnostics, preview a fix, then apply it.

workflowHints.name: Code Action
workflowHints.description: List available Roslyn refactorings/fixes at a location, preview, then apply.

workflowHints.name: Security Audit
workflowHints.description: Check analyzer coverage, get security findings, then fix them.

workflowHints.name: Compile Sanity
workflowHints.description: Use in-memory compilation for routine compile sanity; reserve build_workspace/build_project for CI-parity or project-system validation.

workflowHints.name: Change Validation
workflowHints.description: Use the auto-scoped validation bundle or find tests related to changed files, then run the filtered test slice.

workflowHints.name: Post-edit Verify (auto-scoped)
workflowHints.description: Preferred post-edit bundle: derives changedFilePaths from git status --porcelain and runs compile_check + project_diagnostics + test_related_files scoped to the touched-file set. Falls back to validate_workspace scope with a warning when git is unavailable.

workflowHints.name: Dead Code Cleanup
workflowHints.description: Find unused symbols, preview removal, apply, then verify with compile_check.

workflowHints.name: Package Migration
workflowHints.description: Preview migrating a package across projects, apply, then verify.

workflowHints.name: Coverage Analysis
workflowHints.description: Discover tests, run coverage, scaffold new tests for gaps.

workflowHints.name: SRP Analysis & Type Extraction
workflowHints.description: Identify types with multiple responsibilities via LCOM4 metrics, find shared private members that complicate extraction, preview and apply the extraction, then verify the build.

workflowHints.name: Consumer Impact Analysis
workflowHints.description: Find all types that depend on a type or interface, understand dependency kinds (constructor, field, parameter, base type), then assess change impact.

workflowHints.name: Interface Extraction & Migration
workflowHints.description: Extract an interface from a concrete type, then bulk-replace all parameter/field references to use the interface instead. Verify with build.

workflowHints.name: Type Organization
workflowHints.description: Move types from multi-type files into their own dedicated files for better code organization.

workflowHints.name: Batch Diagnostic Fix
workflowHints.description: List available analyzers and rules, identify diagnostics, batch-fix all occurrences across the solution, then verify the build.

workflowHints.name: Flow Analysis for Refactoring
workflowHints.description: Analyze data and control flow to understand variable dependencies and reachability before extracting code into new types or methods.

workflowHints.name: Quick Validation
